defs.def: living; not dead 活着；在世

ex.s: School can keep those dreams alive by giving kids a way to learn and grow.”
ex.t: 见到格雷西后，作者意识到了什么？

ex.s: After Charlie had a heart attack, Tindale says, she was prepared to put him to sleep, but Farber’s treatments eased her dog’s suffering so much that she was able to keep him alive for an additional five months.
ex.t: 廷代尔说，查理心脏病发作后，她本已准备让它安乐死，但法伯的治疗极大地缓解了她的狗的痛苦，使她能让它多活了五个月。

ex.s: His father frequently amused the boy with a tablet computer which was loaded with colorful pictures that come alive when you poke them.
ex.t: 他的父亲经常用平板电脑逗他开心，平板电脑上加载着彩色图片，一戳就会动。

ex.s: When the explorers first set foot upon the continent of North American, the skies and lands were alive with an astonishing variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 当探险家第一次踏上北美大陆时，天空和大地充满了令人惊叹的各种野生动物。

ex.s: However you start, remember there is no better time to start than right now, for you'll never be more alive than you are at this moment.
ex.t: 记住托马斯·科斯坦57岁时出版了他的第一本小说，而摩西奶奶78岁时才展出她的第一批画作。
当大猩猩和我互相吓到对方时，我很高兴发现它们____68____（它们）还活着。

ex.s: When the gorillas and I frightened each other, I was just glad to find    68   (they) alive.
ex.t: 当大猩猩和我互相吓到对方时，我只为找到它们____68____（they）活着而感到庆幸。

ex.s: I told my father how Mrs Stanley talked as if Mr Stanley were still alive.
ex.t: 当我不说"很好"时，她会留下来听我的问题。

defs.def: full of emotion, excitement, activity, etc. 情绪饱满；激动兴奋；有生气；有活力

ex.s: But I know Jimmy will meet me here if he’s alive, for he always was the truest, staunchest ole chap in the world.
ex.t: 但我知道，如果吉米还活着，他会在这里见到我，因为他一直是世界上最真实、最坚定的人。

ex.s: TOLKIEN LETTERS FROM FATHER CHRISTMAS Edited by BAILLIE TOLKIEN 1 Many people still remember the magic of Father Christmas from when they were children.As parents,they try to keep that magic alive for their children for as long as they can.
ex.t: 托尔金父亲的圣诞节信件由BAILLIE TOLKIEN编辑1许多人仍然记得他们小时候圣诞老人的魔力。作为父母，他们试图尽可能长时间地为孩子保持这种魔力。

ex.s: The letters were Tolkien’s way of keeping Father Christmas alive for his four children, over a period of more than twenty years.
ex.t: 这些信件是托尔金在二十多年的时间里为他的四个孩子保持圣诞老人活着的方式。

ex.s: When we visited the ward the next morning, we were amazed to see that against all odds, both boys were still alive.
ex.t: 当我们第二天早上去病房时，我们惊讶地发现，尽管困难重重，两个男孩都还活着。

ex.s: Staying alive will be a daily challenge, but as proved by the Biosphere 2 experiment, not impossible.
ex.t: 活着将是一项日常挑战，但正如生物圈2实验所证明的那样，并非不可能。

defs.def: continuing to exist 继续存在
full of living or moving things 充满（活的或动的东西）
aware of sth; knowing sth exists and is important 意识到；认识到；注意到
to become interesting and exciting 主题或活动
to become busy and full of activity 地方
to show interest in sth and become excited about it 人
